SUPCASE Galaxy Tab S3 9.7" Case Unicorn Beetle Pro Series Full-Body Rugged with Built-in Screen Protector, Blue/Black (SUP-Galaxy-TabS3-9.7-UBPro-Blue/Black) When I ordered this, I didn't realize that I would be required to use the screen protector part of it. I thought that I could just slip on the back piece and use it like that. When I realized that both pieces are required (the back is too big and wouldn't stay on without the screen protector piece; hey, it's the first time I've ordered something with an integrated screen protector, so I didn't know), I wanted to send it back without even trying it.

I'm glad that I decided to try it for a couple of days, first. The screen is always covered with fingerprints and smudges and I find myself wiping it off many times a day. It also scratches easily. Since we're all washing our hands 40 times a day, the amount of fingerprints feels excessive to me and I hate looking at it. Even so, with the screen protector on, the screen is very responsive. Zero problems. And while I'm actually using my tablet, I don't notice the scratches or fingerprints.

There is also a shimmery rainbow effect. I don't really notice it while the screen is on and it seems to be less of an effect after the couple of weeks that I've been using it. I think because there's less of an air gap.

Everything lines up perfectly and the back part of the case also seems perfect to me. I would love to see this brand make a version that's just the well-fitted back piece.

So is it perfect? No. However, the things that bother me about it aren't really noticeable while the screen is on and I'm using it. It's protective and the screen protector doesn't interfere in the responsiveness of the screen in any way. So overall, I do think that this purchase was worth it. I'm glad that I decided to try it instead of immediately sending it back.

Another comment -- I keep a little piece of electrical tape over the front camera hole. The screen protector holds the tape in place so that I don't have to periodically change it anymore.
text_fidelity_b: SUPCASE Galaxy Tab S3 9.7" Case Unicorn Beetle Pro Series Full-Body Rugged with Built-in Screen Protector, Blue/Black (SUP-Galaxy-TabS3-9.7-UBPro-Blue/Black)

Skullcandy Hesh ANC Wireless Over-Ear Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headphones for iPhone and Android with Microphone / 22 Hour Battery Life / Best for Music, School, Workouts, Travel, and Gaming - White Skullcandy’s description says it all: wireless simplicity with noise canceling. These aren’t headphones for audiophiles who want to control and customize every sound option. These are headphones for people who want affordable Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and decent sound output.

I’ve noticed the ANC works better when I’m listening to music rather than if I’m watching a tv show or movie to cancel out the background noise in my home. If I am watching a show, I can hear someone else watching a video in the next room; the noise of their video is cut about 75-80%. If I have music on, the noise of their video is cut about 90-100%, depending on the type of music.

Switching ANC on and off is easy. The headphones have a dedicated button for that, one second press to turn on, one second press to turn off. So it’s very quick if I need to hear someone speaking. The button has a raised open circle (◯) on it, so once you get used to the different symbols on the buttons, it’s very easy to feel it. The headphones also provide audio indicators (“Noise cancelling off/on”) when turning the ANC on and off.

The other buttons include + for volume up/track forward, ⚫ for power/play/pause, and -- for volume down/track back. I’ve used Skullcandy headphones for years when working outside, and I really like that they keep using physical buttons. I find physical buttons so much easier to use and know what button I’m pressing.

Sound quality is okay. I’ve noticed that the bass seems punchy, like I can feel it echoing against my ears. I don’t often mess with sound profiles, but this is a case where I would try to reduce the bass for my audio comfort. Otherwise, the sound is average to good.

The headphones stayed in place on my head, from sitting at my desk to walking around the house, folding laundry, and putting it away. I didn’t try with intensive activity, but as I mentioned above, I’ve used the previous versions of Skullcandy Hesh for working outside and they stay put. These look and feel almost identical to my old Hesh headphones, so I’m confident these will perform the same. They are tight; I sometimes get a headache when wearing them.

The headphones charge via USB-C. The box includes a USB cable and an audio cable. I used the headphones for about a week, probably 20 hours, before needing to charge. I like that I can get 3 hours of use with a 10 minute charge, very handy for if I’m going somewhere and forgot to charge ahead of time.
text_fidelity_b: Skullcandy Hesh ANC Wireless Over-Ear Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headphones for iPhone and Android with Microphone / 22 Hour Battery Life / Best for Music, School, Workouts, Travel, and Gaming - White

Fisher Price Precious Planet Whale of a Tub We purchased this product before we were expecting, knowing that it was neutral gendered and would be perfect for a boy or a girl. When we had our first child, a 9 lb, 11 oz baby girl, I was SO nervous! I didn't know a thing about babies. My eldest sister helped me give her her first bath and complimented our whale tub. She said it was so nice that the green padding in the base would help prevent baby from slipping. By the third bath, I had it down.

As the weeks have gone on, our little one has really loved her tub. She began holding her head up at 4 days old and was doing so independently within a month of her birth. She loved kicking and splashing in her tub. She has never cried in the bath. We use a turtlemeter thermometer and she thinks of it like a little toy with which to play.

I would recommend this tub with the seat in it for a newborn baby up to about 12 lbs. Once our daughter was 13 lbs, she has trouble staying warm in the tub with the seat attached. It simply wasn't deep enough for her while she was lying down and she only got her bottom half wet unless I poured water over her, and the chilly air would then make her cold.

With the seat out, she needs to be sitting on her own so there was a two month gap where we did not use her tub, and instead bathed her with me in the big tub.

Once she was a successful sitter, we returned her to this tub for warmer nights, so she could sit and play in the water. She loves it!

After a bath, I would recommend not only using the drain in the tub, but turning this whale tub upside-down and and then turning it from side-to-side to drain it, as the water tends to get trapped beneath the green padded area. You can also remove the seat to clean under it. Using dish soap and a scrub daddy sponge, I am able to quickly clean the tub in-between uses.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher Price Precious Planet Whale of a Tub

Kindle Oasis E-reader with Leather Charging Cover - Black, 6" High-Resolution Display (300 ppi), Wi-Fi + Free Cellular Connectivity, Built-In Audible (Previous Generation - 8th) “I wonder how long it has been we readers have gazed at the young person sitting under a tree at night reading a book on the Kindle home screen..oh, our love affair with books and being able to read our stories late into the night…...by candlelight….anywhere.”

Pre-release technology reviewers commenting on the price of the Kindle Oasis are wrong. The new Kindle Oasis is worth the the price Amazon is charging, including cover it hardly represents at all an increase in price when compared with a Kindle Voyage with cover. Yet it provides the two most asked for improvements in mobile devices: increased battery life reducing the need to frequently recharge, and improved screen legibility (new sans-serif Ember font, and more LEDS that provide increased brightness).

“When we are immersed into the story of our favorite books, only that world matters.”

Pre-release technology reviewers have compared the Kindle as a single purpose e-reader, to multipurpose devices like in smartphones, tablets and computers. When we choose to read, we are seeking a bit of solitude in the day and night. Oh, how easy it is to remember being annoyed with yet another incoming phone call, text message or email. The power of focus!

“The tactile feel of a book”

Pre-release technology reviewer have labelled the Kindle as luxurious with it’s leather cover. How soon we forget our books covered with leather! And we are willing to pay an extra price for it!

As I sit across the street from the one and only Amazon retail store “in the world”, I have unboxed and set up my new Kindle Oasis. Maybe I am one of the few ordinary people outside of Amazon and the technology press in the world to have been able to purchase one so soon. The feeling reminds me of going to a release party in the same shopping center for the latest Harry Potter novel.
